changes.problem: 18 posts use a one-off grey note class (.mp-note, .et-note, .tr-note) falling below WCAG AA contrast standards.
changes.risk: Could slightly alter the author's intended hue for customized callout blocks.

changes.problem: 18 posts feature a content column narrower than 300px on phones due to a rigid padded outer wrapper.
changes.risk: Might slightly reduce margins on specific deeply-nested legacy post templates.

changes.problem: Per-table issues like 27-column tables and headerless layouts degrade tabular data readability on small viewports.
changes.change: #Blog1 .post-body table.gs-t td, #Blog1 .post-body table.gs-t th { font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem !important; }
changes.risk: Dense tables with smaller text may become slightly harder to scan for readers with low vision.

changes.problem: Fine print, disclaimers, and source notes sit below 15px across 365 posts, reducing legibility for phone readers.
changes.risk: Increases overall vertical length of posts containing extensive footnotes.

changes.problem: Long links and file paths still cause horizontal overflow on mobile despite `overflow-wrap: anywhere` on links.
changes.change: #Blog1 .post-body a[href^='data:'], #Blog1 .post-body a[href*='/files/'], #Blog1 .post-body a[href*='.pdf'], #Blog1 .post-body a[href*='.csv'] { word-break: break-all; }
changes.risk: May break links with special characters (e.g., `&`, `#`) if not already handled by `overflow-wrap: anywhere`

changes.problem: WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) not met for fine-print disclaimers (15px or smaller) in 365 posts.
changes.risk: Could clash with posts using custom fine-print styling (e.g., dark mode). Test on 5% of posts first.

changes.problem: Ads in narrow content columns (<300px) on mobile appear unusable (too small for tap targets).
changes.change: #Blog1 .post-body .google-auto-placed { min-height: 120px; max-width: 100%; } /* Force minimum ad size */
changes.risk: May cause layout shifts if ads expand beyond container. Test with `will-change: transform` on ads.

changes.problem: Tables with >27 columns still lack horizontal scrolling on mobile (ragged rows).
changes.change: #Blog1 .post-body table.gs-t.gs-wide { min-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; } /* Force scroll for wide tables */
changes.risk: Could break tables with fixed-width headers if not already wrapped in `.gs-tblwrap`

changes.problem: Accessibility toolbar (side-by-side row) breaks ad placement, causing ads to appear clipped.
changes.change: #Blog1 .post-body .accessibility-toolbar { display: block; margin: 1rem 0; } /* Stack vertically on mobile */
changes.risk: May hide toolbar icons if not already mobile-responsive. Test with `flex-direction: column` fallback.

changes.problem: Ads directly under headings are moved *above* headings, breaking visual flow.
changes.risk: AdSense may flag this as a placement change. Monitor for policy violations.

changes.problem: List items still exceed 95 characters in 51 posts (despite `max-width: 64ch`).
changes.change: #Blog1 .post-body ol li, #Blog1 .post-body ul li { hyphens: auto; } /* Enable hyphenation for long list items */
changes.risk: Hyphenation may not work for all languages or fonts. Test with `font-family: Georgia, serif` fallback.

changes.problem: Code blocks overflow horizontally on phones, pushing content sideways.
changes.change: #Blog1 .post-body pre { font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.3; } /* Reduce code block density */
changes.risk: May reduce readability for small code snippets. Test with `min-height: 120px` for monospace.

changes.problem: Ads in multi-column grids (stat tiles) appear disjointed from content.
changes.change: #Blog1 .post-body .google-auto-placed:not(:has(ins[data-ad-status='filled'])) { margin: 0.5rem 0; } /* Add spacing for empty ads */
changes.risk: Could increase perceived ad density. Test with `opacity: 0.1` for empty states.

changes.problem: Sticky header cuts off section links by 76px (desktop), but mobile users still scroll under headings.
changes.risk: May cause links to appear under header on very short posts. Test with `min-height: 100px` fallback.

keep: Because it correctly scopes homepage styles (`.hero`, `.wrap`, `.card`) to the homepage only, preventing post contamination.

changes.problem: 18 posts have a content wrapper narrower than 300 px on phones, causing ads and text to be cramped.
changes.risk: If a post uses a custom narrow column for design, it will be forced wider, which may affect layout but improves readability and ad visibility.

changes.problem: Auto‑ads containers can be narrower than 300 px on phones, making the ad unit look broken.
changes.risk: Adds horizontal margin that may slightly increase page length; does not affect ad serving.

changes.problem: Custom note classes (.mp-note, .et-note, .tr-note) have insufficient contrast (3.0–3.9:1).
changes.risk: Overrides author‑chosen note colors; may alter visual hierarchy but brings contrast to WCAG AA.

changes.problem: Long words inside list items can still cause horizontal overflow on phones.
changes.risk: None – only affects wrapping behavior.

changes.problem: Fine‑print and disclaimer text (often <15 px) can exceed the 64 ch measure, leading to very long lines on desktop.
changes.risk: May wrap text earlier than author intended; improves line length consistency.

changes.problem: Code blocks with long lines cause horizontal scrolling despite overflow‑x:auto on <pre>.
changes.change: #Blog1 .post-body pre code { overflow-wrap: anywhere; word-break: break-word; }
changes.risk: None – only changes wrapping inside code snippets.

changes.problem: Auto‑ads placed directly after a heading can appear too close to the heading, reducing visual separation.
changes.risk: Adds extra vertical space; may affect ad density but improves readability.

changes.problem: Blockquotes inherit the 64 ch max‑width but their inner paragraphs can still exceed optimal line length on large screens.
changes.risk: Minimal – only affects blockquote text width.

changes.problem: Table captions can be long and push the table width beyond the column on small screens.
changes.change: #Blog1 .post-body table.gs-t caption { display: block; width: 100%; word-break: break-word; }
changes.risk: May wrap caption text earlier; improves table layout on narrow viewports.

keep: gs-scope-chrome-v1 – isolates homepage styles (.hero, .wrap, .card) so they no longer leak into post content.
gs-table-template-v1 – provides a consistent, readable table style and already moves ads out of tables.
gs-readable-v1 – caps line length, fixes long‑word overflow, improves contrast and heading scroll margin.
gs-content-guard-v2 – moves Auto‑ads out of tables, lists, figures, code blocks, collapsible sections, grids, and boxed notes, preventing ads from breaking content structures.
